name: Smurfs Coin
rootCause: The Smurfs Coin project is an exit scam, and the contract deployer sold the tokens on June 13 and removed a total of 227 ETH (approximately $423,000) of liquidity. The contract address is ETH: 0x5F250ed62CF3E5cF25F4F370d35D04782b0678a3, not to be confused with a project with a similar name.
